title: AC1009 paper-space DWG-to-DXF route and writer-path correction
mode: Broader primary-source research, cross-implementation semantic cross-check, and implementation-readiness refinement

localScope.worktreeState: The shared worktree was already broadly modified. This pass changed only the parity plan and this research receipt; production and test source were not edited.

sources.observation: dwgRW::createReaderForVersion dispatches AC1009 to dwgReaderR11. readEntityR11 consumes the mandatory extension byte when FLAG_HAS_PSPACE is set, but its shared applyAttrs lambda assigns layer/color/linetype and not DRW_Entity::space. The generic dxfRW writer already emits the fixed legacy $MODEL_SPACE and $PAPER_SPACE BLOCK records on the AC1009 lane; entity output selects paper-space ownership and emits group 67 from ent.space. No generated full-route reproduction was run.
sources.disposition: Correct the candidate from missing output-container synthesis to a possible source-to-callback entity-space projection loss. The writer has a source-confirmed legacy container/serialization path; only parser classification and complete generated-route behavior remain to validate.

sources.sourcePin: Public issue and PR pages viewed 2026-10-21; PR #1368 displayed Open.
sources.observation: LibreDWG's common_entity_data.spec explicitly sets entmode=1 and emits DXF group 67 when FLAG_R11_HAS_PSPACE is set. Issue #1337 and open PR #1368 report a 3-model/5-paperspace split matching AutoCAD for that project's AC1009 case. The PR's missing pre-R13 internal BLOCK_HEADER and same-version pseudo-block naming issues are LibreDWG-specific paths; its corpus and AutoCAD comparisons were not independently reproduced here.
sources.disposition: Treat the peer decoder source as strong semantic corroboration and a focused test-shape lead, not ODA byte authority or proof of local end-to-end behavior. The PR remained open in the reviewed page. Do not fetch or commit issue attachments.

sources.observation: Autodesk documents model/paper-space block definitions and group 67 distinction and warns against relying on group-code ordering. ezdxf documents that R12 uses $MODEL_SPACE/$PAPER_SPACE, stores the single paper-space layout through the legacy route, and differs from R13+ multi-layout BLOCK_RECORD/LAYOUT structures.
sources.disposition: Use these sources for the expected DXF artifact version and independent output-parser check only; ezdxf does not establish pre-R13 DWG flag semantics.

sources.observation: The locally reviewed v5.4.1 material did not resolve the AC1009/R11 record-level HAS_PSPACE semantic needed for this route.
sources.disposition: Keep ODA as DWG byte-layout authority. Peer source may guide a generated projection control, but do not treat generated self-consistency as producer proof; seek an admissible existing pre-R13 producer trace before promoting format-level qualification.

planChanges: Corrected the historical statement that AC1009 DWG was out of scope: the current worktree dispatches AC1009 through dwgReaderR11.
Recorded a candidate AC1009 entity-space projection loss without incrementing the confirmed finding or subplan count.

Corrected the earlier container-gap hypothesis: local dxfRW::writeBlocks emits the fixed AC1009 $MODEL_SPACE/$PAPER_SPACE BLOCK pair, and entity emission uses DRW_Entity::space for group 67 and paper-space ownership.

Added LibreDWG common_entity_data.spec as strong secondary semantic corroboration for HAS_PSPACE -> entmode 1/group 67, while retaining ODA authority and requiring producer-trace evidence for format-level qualification.

Refined the scratch-only generated AC1009-to-R12 control to assert callback-space projection, one fixed legacy BLOCK pair, group 67, exact ENTITIES membership, source/output identity, and strict reopen; optional AC1015 output is a separate target-version control.
Kept the AC1009 case separate from PAR-144's R13+ layout graph and PAR-143's unsupported pre-R13 marker semantics; specified fast owning-target validation and self-unblocking.

existingOwners: Pre-R13 DWG reader matrix / dwgReaderR11 route
PAR-143 remains limited to REPEAT/ENDREP/LOAD semantics

limitations: The LibreDWG report and proposed PR were not executed or independently reproduced, and PR #1368 remained open at review time. The local writer path was source-audited but the complete AC1009 route was not generated or executed; the candidate callback-space loss remains unconfirmed end-to-end. No external drawing was downloaded.
